attributes.body_ja:
「つもりで」は、名詞（めいし）「つもり」（意味（いみ）：意図（いと））と格助詞（かくじょし）「で」の組（く）み合（あ）わせで、その前（まえ）に置（お）かれる語句（ごく）によっていろいろな使（つか）い方（かた）ができます。動詞（どうし）の普通形（ふつうけい）やナ形容詞（けいようし）、名詞（めいし）と組（く）み合（あ）わせると、「(A) という意図（いと）で (B) をする」という意味（いみ）になります。

「つもり」は名詞（めいし）なので、他（ほか）の名詞（めいし）と一緒（いっしょ）に使（つか）うときは「の」が必要（ひつよう）です。また、ナ形容詞（けいようし）と繋（つな）げるときは「な」が必要（ひつよう）です。

ただし、「つもりで」を動詞（どうし）の過去形（かこけい）と組（く）み合（あ）わせると、話（はな）し手（て）が「(A) のように行動（こうどう）する」「(A) のふりをする」「(A) だと思（おも）い込（こ）んでいる」のような意味（いみ）になります。

このような意味（いみ）は、話（はな）し手（て）の意図（いと）が実際（じっさい）とは違（ちが）うことから生（う）まれています。
attributes.body:
つもりで, being a combination of the noun つもり 'intention', and the case marking particleで 'with', this structure is used in several different ways, depending on what comes before it. When combined with verbs, な-Adjectives or nouns in their plain forms, it implies that (B) is being done with the intention of (A).

As つもり is a noun, の will be required before it when grouped with other nouns, while な will be required when linked to な-Adjectives.

However, when paired with verbs in the past form, つもりで implies that the speaker is 'acting as though (A)', 'pretending that (A)', or 'is convinced that (A)'.

This meaning simply comes from the intention of something being contrary to what is actually true.

予定だ expresses a concrete future plan, e.g. 来年日本に行く予定だ ('I plan to go to Japan next year.'). つもり is often less concrete and, in つもりで form, connects actions with intention, e.g. 遊ぶつもりで行った 'went with the intention of having fun'. It can also mean 'believing (A)' as in 俳優になったつもりで話す 'speak as if you were (lit. with the belief that you had become) an actor'.

attributes.body: つもり basically means 'intention.' When used at the end of a sentence in the form つもりだ, it expresses future plans, similar to 'I intend to' or 'I hope to.' In the form つもりで, it connects to another part of the sentence and means doing something with a certain intention or belief in mind. When preceded by a past tense verb, つもり can also mean 'pretending' or 'acting as if... (though it's not actually the case).'
